designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1973 on surplus military land transferred from the U.S. Army and Coast Guard; run as a state-managed wildlife management area until the Service took over refuge management in 1991.

authority.citation: Transfer of surplus federal property, 16 U.S.C. 667b

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Salinas River National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
Salinas River NWR Comprehensive Conservation Plan (FWS, 2002, archived): established in 1973 on surplus military land transferred from the Army and Coast Guard, under 16 U.S.C. 667b
FWS Salinas River NWR brochure, 2008 (NPS History copy): "Established in 1973"

review.note: About-us page says 1972; the refuge CCP and brochure both say 1973.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Established in 1972 through local activism, the refuge provides not only critical habitat for threatened and endangered species...
